sn21.5:1.2: atha kho āyasmā sujāto yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami.
sn21.5:1.3: addasā kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ sujātaṃ dūratova āgacchantaṃ.
sn21.5:1.6: yañca abhirūpo dassanīyo pāsādiko paramāya vaṇṇapokkharatāya samannāgato, yassa catthāya kulaputtā sammadeva agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajjanti, tadanuttaraṃ brahmacariyapariyosānaṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharatīti.
